content.text: At 5, the move works best with a clear, consistent bridge: put a mattress or sleeping bag on his floor, start there yourself for a few nights until he falls asleep, then gradually shift toward the door and out. Keep the bedtime routine identical each night so the familiarity does the calming work his closeness to you used to do.

input.offer: Want the full night-by-night plan for Milo? Reply YES and I'll send it.
